rationale: BLSH gapped up ~10% at the open and has already pulled back from the session high of $21.60 to $21.20, with the last candle showing a bearish close below the open after a wide-range first bar — suggesting the initial gap momentum is fading. With price oscillating around VWAP and the 9-EMA without a clear directional setup, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure alongside the existing working order.
